floor_history.headline: recon: floor=2 is pure sched1 lbu-emission-order swap in FALSE-color branch; regs+opcodes identical, only [b,r,g] vs [r,g,b]; statement-reorder KILLED

frontier.hypothesis: player is a struct type; casting via a struct with named u8 fields at 0x18/0x19/0x1A changes MEM_IN_STRUCT_P (`/s` flag) on the lbu MEMs, altering sched.c true_dependence edges enough to push b earlier. Proven-spelling-class family carve-out (InitHiraRmd_80041AC8 precedent).
frontier.mechanism: sched.c `true_dependence` in-struct escape clause: `/s`=1 MEMs skip dependence with certain other MEMs, changing sched1 ready-set / priority evaluation.
frontier.next_probe: Cast player through `struct { u8 pad18[0x18]; u8 r,g,b,pad; } *p = (…)player;` and access `p->r/g/b`. Run sandbox; if score drops to 0, run cheat-reviewer (proven-spelling-class needs mechanism proof).

frontier.hypothesis: Rewrite the else branch to load b via a separate pre-expression walking pointer while r,g load via a different pointer/base — the resulting dependence graph may reorder loads without changing bytes.
frontier.mechanism: Different base-pointer pseudos → distinct MEM alias sets → sched.c dependence graph re-organized; may bump b's priority via a longer dependence chain from a walking-pointer post-increment (walking-pointer-serializes-parallel-loads family, opposite polarity).
frontier.next_probe: Try `u8 *bp = (u8*)player + 0x1A; b = *bp; r = *(bp-2); g = *(bp-1);` and permute. Sandbox each variant. Report chain-length delta via cc1 `-da` .sched dump under tmp/grind/gnd_init_80041688/s2/.

frontier.hypothesis: Ternary consolidation: `gnd_load_tex(func_800486FC() ? complex_true : complex_false)` — replaces the if/else with a conditional expression, might restructure the whole basic block graph so the FALSE-color loads schedule differently (or the true+false blocks unify via cross-jump).
frontier.mechanism: if/else → COND_EXPR RTL changes BB boundaries and could allow jump.c cross-jump merge of the tail; sched1 sees a different block layout.
frontier.next_probe: Rewrite the tail as `gnd_load_tex(func_800486FC() ? (...v...) : (b|((r<<16)|(g<<8))));`, sandbox, and diff. Confirm no cheat-by-any-spelling per no-new-park-categories.
